verdicts.reason: Both candidates have nearly the same layout and the same flaws. The hero photo has become a small, washed-out strip floating in a big empty white column. The yellow highlight bars have moved away from the headline and sit as loose fragments at the bottom, and the circle motif has shrunk to specks. The headline sits off-centre in empty space, so the original's layered photo-and-text composition is lost. The only differences are tiny: the semicircle and headline positions shift by a few pixels, and neither change makes one better than the other.
